summary: Tested the MOD Operations integrity sprint on the backend and in the UI. Backend: the new tests/test_mod_ops_integrity_iter323.py passes 19 of 20 tests. The regression suites (iter322 wizard/delete, bfpo_portal_jan2026, bfpo_engineer_invite_jan2026) pass 41, with 4 skipped. Results: /api/bfpo/sites returns 7 bfpo_site + 74 mod_site entries for staff, only BFPO sites for a lead, and only the engineer's own visible sites for an engineer (a mod_site org for site-only, territory sites plus explicit sites for both). /staff/team coverage is correct for the sites-only, territory-only, territory+sites, none and multi-country cases. Missing ids show missing:true and an issue, and an inactive account shows an issue. Unknown ids get 422 on create and PATCH with nothing saved, and duplicates are removed. The Master Admin PATCH validates the same way (422), and changes show up identically in both directions. Engineer job visibility is limited to coverage until the job is allocated. Allocate returns 409 outside_coverage, then 200 with override_reason, and the reason is in the timeline. Allocating to a deactivated engineer returns 409. Deactivate returns 409 open_jobs with the job list. A bad decision (empty reason) returns 422 and nothing changes. Valid reassign/unassign/keep decisions are applied and logged. A deactivated engineer's old token gets 403, login gets 403 'Account disabled', and resend-invite gets 409 without reactivating. Reactivation restores access. Quotes: published, customer_review and authorisation_submitted groups get 409 'recall it first', withdraw then delete returns 200, and the snapshot holds the group, quotes, events, authorisations and follow-ups. Accepted and handed_over groups get 409, a draft gets 200, and /deleted is owner-only. Follow-up wording: GET, PUT as manager (resets approval), PUT as rep (403), approve as non-owner (403), approve as owner, edit resets approval, invalid PUT returns 422 and keeps the approval, and /followups/run has live_email false. UI: engineer rows show the login badge, the coverage badge, separate Territories/Specific sites lines and issues, and 'No territories' is gone. John Maina shows Territories: Kenya (BATUK) and Specific sites: BATUK Nyati Barracks Gym (read-only check). StaffJobDetail marks options '— outside normal coverage', shows the amber box, keeps Save disabled until a reason is entered, then saves and shows the reason in the timeline. The deactivate modal shows per-job controls with Confirm gated on reasons, and after it the engineer shows Deactivated with the resend icon hidden. The owner sees Recall but no mq-delete on a published group. After Recall, Delete appears and removes the group. The Follow-ups wording panel (state label, toggle, 3 editors, save, approve) works end to end. Bugs found: 1 HIGH backend (an old invite link reactivates a deactivated engineer) and 1 MEDIUM UI (an engineer with a dangling coverage reference cannot be edited at all).

critical.issue: This reactivates a deactivated engineer. invite_accept sets is_active:true without checking the account, and deactivation does not revoke pending bfpo_invites. Repro: create an engineer in invite mode, deactivate them via /staff/engineers/{id}/status (no jobs), then POST the still-valid invite token to /invite/{token}/accept. users.is_active becomes true and the engineer can sign in. This bypasses the 'resend invite must not reactivate' rule (test_pending_invite_cannot_reactivate fails). Fix: in set_engineer_status(active=false), db.bfpo_invites.delete_many({user_id}). Also make invite_accept refuse (or not touch is_active) when the user is_active is False, and make GET /invite/{token} return valid:false for disabled users.

minor.issue: Dry-run chases use up the schedule. When live is false (switch off or wording not approved), each due chase is still marked status 'done' with customer_email 'dry_run'. When MOD_QUOTE_NOTIFY_LIVE is turned on later, the customer never gets those 2/4/6-week emails. 8 preview groups already have dry_run-consumed chases. Consider leaving them pending, or adding an explicit 'dry_run' status that is retried once live.

Reassign during deactivation does not check coverage, so a job can go to an engineer outside coverage with no outside-coverage record. The modal's engineer dropdown has no '— outside normal coverage' marker either. This is inconsistent with requirement (2). The reason is logged, but coverage_override is not set.

'Keep with management' leaves assigned_engineer_id pointing at the deactivated engineer and sets deactivated_engineer_hold:true. Nothing clears the hold on reactivation, and no manager is recorded as the holder.
This is not scoped to bfpo-mod-org or the MOD ops org filter, and it does not 404 for an unknown engineer. Any user id returns that user's open cases from any org (staff-only, low risk).

ui_bugs.issue: An engineer whose bfpo_site_ids or bfpo_territory_ids hold a deleted or unknown id cannot be saved, even for a name-only change. The form copies the raw ids, the PATCH always resends bfpo_territory_ids/bfpo_site_ids, and the backend returns 422 'Coverage not saved — unknown site X'. The missing id is not in the site picker, so the user cannot untick it. Verified in the UI with a TEST engineer. Fix: show missing ids as removable chips (or strip coverage.missing ids from the form), and/or send coverage fields only when they changed.

issues: The tab intro still says 'the customer is emailed the quotation PDFs'. While the wording is unapproved or the live switch is off, that is not true. Make the copy conditional.
About 81 sites are rendered as chip buttons with no search or grouping. It is a long scroll to find a site.
Cancel and 'Deactivate engineer' render with the same filled-blue style. Deactivate should look destructive and Cancel secondary.
The open-jobs GET is outside try/catch, so a failure is an unhandled rejection with no row error.

action_items: HIGH: Revoke pending bfpo_invites when an engineer is deactivated, and make /invite/{token}/accept refuse (or not set is_active) for deactivated users
MEDIUM: StaffEngineers edit — let staff remove dangling (missing) territory/site ids, or send coverage only when it changed, so a name/phone edit is not blocked by 422
Decide how dry-run follow-up chases should behave so they are not lost when the live switch is turned on
Optional: apply the coverage check/marker to the deactivation reassign target; clear deactivated_engineer_hold on reactivation; scope /open-jobs to the BFPO org; fix the Follow-ups intro copy
critical_code_review_comments: bfpo_coverage.py is a clean single source of truth (lookup/validate/describe/covers_case), and Master Admin and MOD Ops use the same validator.
_require_bfpo checks is_active/active, so old tokens are rejected even though get_current_user does not check tokens_revoked_before for access tokens.
covers_case returns True for every lead, so leads never trigger the outside-coverage warning (intentional, but undocumented in the UI).
The Master Admin PATCH clears coverage whenever is_mod_bfpo is falsy and mod_bfpo is not sent. Legacy engineers without is_mod_bfpo would lose coverage on a name-only edit.
routes/bfpo.py (1616 lines) and master_admin_mod_estate.py (2303 lines) are well over the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested UI checks pass; 1 medium edit bug)
